store_fix.v6_rule: the store is moved with the registered prior (locations.move_store(store, shift): o, loc_center and rect + shift; key frame_shift records it). b0_conditions_v2.rule_source: decision request v1 (docs/experiments/phd/main_prep_discard_rule_v1/버리는기준_결정요청_v1.md) 2 'na' option 3, chosen by the user on 2026-10-06; written here as the config v2 the order refers to (no v2 file existed before)
b0_conditions_v2.pool: the COVER training views (prep step01/b0.json, 209 = 40 nadir + 169 oblique; nadir = tilt <= 20 degrees)
b0_conditions_v2.shared_points: 3-D points of the 937-image sparse model observed in both views (COLMAP images.bin point ids); a pair overlaps when it shares >= 29 points (the author A3 pair)
b0_conditions_v2.selection: 1) start pair = the (nadir, oblique) pair sharing >= 29 points with the largest number of target-building patches seen by either view (ties: lexicographic order of the two names); 2) then add views one by one, first nadir views up to the nadir count, then oblique views: a candidate must share >= 29 points with at least one view already chosen; take the candidate adding the most not-yet-seen target patches (ties: name order). Target patches and visibility = discard_v1 b0_conditions (LoD2 patches of DEBY_LOD2_4959323, visibility pairs of the prep COVER stage-1 run, prior render only)
b0_conditions_v2.mvs: training images only, the pinned COLMAP image colmap/colmap@sha256:187ca5ec98e5... and the settings of the discard task (geom_consistency, max_image_size 1024, 3 iterations, filter)
b0_conditions_v2.mvs_stands: a condition's MVS stands when at least 2 training views and at least half of its training views get a geometric depth map; otherwise stop and ask
b0_conditions_v2.fixed_values: tolerance and registration = the B0 crop values of the discard task (s52/s03/B0: LoD2 roof 0.198 / wall 0.547 m, no shift; ALS 0.127 m, shift (-0.048, 0.043, 0) m)
b0_conditions_v2.runs: s03_stage1_v6 (rule auto) for N13, N8, N2 and, again with v6, the author conditions A15, A9, A3 and COVER; labels s04_gt_v6 on the B0 GT of the discard task (s52/gt/B0)
b0_conditions_v2.table: per condition and prior / face kind, counting area = target building footprint + 2 m (prep case 6): share of confidence-1 pixels among the prior pixels of the target building (coverage_footprints), patch states support / missing / invisible, inherit share, discard counts and wrong discard / wrong keep against the labels

agreement_regions.data: pre-training only: the v6 box stage-1 run (box MVS = training images, fixed values) and its v6 labels
agreement_regions.patches: patches of the box evaluation range (moved centres)
agreement_regions.no_gt: patches without a label (< 5 GT points) or in an excluded cell (trees, transient; ALS also prior-side trees): shown, never compared
agreement_regions.all: true agree: |GT - prior| <= tau (tau of the patch kind, base value)
agreement_regions.measured: all & state support & |MVS - GT| <= tau, MVS - prior = -(median of the signed residual r over the patch's confidence-1 pixels in its supporting views), GT - prior = the label's median (vertical on roof-like, along the outward normal on wall-like patches)
agreement_regions.remainder: all & support & |MVS - GT| > tau: measured but the image is off by more than tau; shown, in neither comparison

compare_later.measured: detail accuracy against prior-as-is and always-trust (image-only also shown)

agreement_regions.metrics: decided separately by the user; this task fixes the regions only
agreement_regions.outputs: per site x prior regions_<site>_<prior>.npz (patch id, moved centre, kind, area, label, state, region code), summary counts and areas, GT coverage (share of evaluation-range patches / area with a label), plan maps

stage0.inputs: fork inputs v6 of B173nb_b10 (training views = box training views with a geometric depth map, evaluation views = box evaluation views; 1024 x 741)
stage0.normal_mode: cell for both priors (r10: ALS cell = main comparison; LoD2 file = the same plane normal for planar faces; r11's run_fork used cell for both)
stage0.base_optimisation: GeoGS / 2DGS defaults of the fork (r10 'training.schedule'): densify 500-15,000 every 100, opacity reset every 3,000, normal consistency from 7,000 (lambda_normal 0.05), depth distortion 0, position lr schedule to 30,000; resolution -r 1 (1024 x 741)

records.monitor_views: the first two training views of split.json

stop_signals.error: exit code != 0, a traceback, or no point cloud at 30,000
stop_signals.nan: a non-finite loss term in any scalars row (r12 itself raises at it)
stop_signals.opacity_collapse: at a logged iteration that is a multiple of 1,000 and >= 2,000: median opacity of the prior-origin Gaussians < 0.05 AND share of prior-origin Gaussians with opacity >= 0.5 < 0.05 (the July trial: roof material at opacity 0.004)
stop_signals.action: the watcher stops that training (docker stop), writes stop.json and progress.md; the other training continues; batch 2 is not started; then ask

stage0.progress: payload progress.md: rewritten when a task changes and every 1,000 iterations (iteration, s / 1,000 iterations, expected end); after the first 1,000 iterations the 30,000 estimate is recomputed from that speed

timing_method.wall: docker run wall time on the host (monotonic)
timing_method.pre_training: stage-1 measurement of the site (s03 timings pass1 + pass2 + pass3 + judgment, per prior) + fork inputs + the fork's initialisation (r12 init seconds: product load, rule, propagation, seating, first E, g_p maps)
timing_method.reread: sum of r12's per-call seconds of the re-read (cuda-synchronised), first call excluded
timing_method.monitoring: read-outs, snapshots, dumps (r12 seconds) = record keeping, not the method
timing_method.loop: wall - initialisation - re-read - monitoring = the base loop with the method's loss terms
timing_method.memory: torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated and max_memory_reserved (scalars), and the GPU's memory.used sampled by nvidia-smi every 30 s on the host (peak minus the idle value before the start)
timing_method.for_image_only: the stage-1 image-only training (switch prior 0) is measured the same way (its re-read time is reported separately; the base implementation without the judgment = jbgs_judgment off)

post.renders: evaluation views: RGB, expected depth (surf_depth), rendered normal (rend_normal), accumulated opacity
post.tsdf: training views only, expected depth, Open3D ScalableTSDFVolume (fork GaussianExtractor.extract_mesh_bounded), voxel 0.05 m, sdf_trunc 0.25 m, depth_trunc 300 m, fusion limited to the box rectangle + 2 m and z in [5th percentile of the box GT z - 5 m, max GT z + 5 m] (pixels outside -> depth 0), one mesh at a time

quick_gt_check.status: a check only (점검용), not the main experiment's metrics
quick_gt_check.gt: B173nb_b10 box GT points of the discard task (s52/box_gt: cleaned ULS 2024-12-17 nadir, aligned), excluded cells removed (any: trees, transient)
quick_gt_check.roof_points: GT points inside a LoD2 GroundSurface footprint of the box and not on vertical surfaces (v4 rule: 0.5 m voxel PCA |n_z| < 0.5 with >= 5 points; single-return)
quick_gt_check.wall_points: GT points on vertical surfaces (same rule), single-return
quick_gt_check.height_difference: roof points: z_result - z_GT, z_result = the highest intersection of the TSDF mesh with the vertical line through the point; median and NMAD (1.4826 MAD)
quick_gt_check.within: unsigned distance from each GT point to the TSDF mesh; shares <= 0.2 m and <= 0.5 m (roof points, wall points, all)

splits.changed: roof points inside the plan polygons of the two B173 wing roof faces (sites_v1 B173_wings)
splits.agreement: points owned by patches of the prior's agreement region (5.3), and its measured / unmeasured parts; ownership = the s04 label rule (roof: vertical line to the registered prior, top layer 1 m; wall: along the wall normal within 2 m)
splits.unseen: old upper wall: points owned by LoD2 wall patches of DEBY_LOD2_4959326 whose state is invisible in the v6 LoD2 box run (the same point set for both priors' results); plus the share of those patch centres within 0.2 / 0.5 m of the result mesh (does the result keep the old prior wall)

quick_gt_check.spread: per prior: the difference of every check number between seed 0 and seed 1 (batch 2), and the visible differences in the figures

figures.views: evaluation views: the 2 nadir (tilt <= 20 deg) and 2 oblique views whose projection of the B173 roof centroid lies nearest the image centre
figures.eval_vs_render: photo and render side by side (both priors, each seed)
figures.depth: rendered expected depth (common colour scale) and rendered normal
figures.mesh: TSDF mesh shaded: top view (orthographic, box rectangle) and one oblique view (the first oblique figure view's camera)

sections.B173_wing: vertical plane through the centroid of the larger B173 wing roof face, along its horizontal normal (across the ridge), +-15 m
sections.B173_middle: vertical plane through the area-weighted centroid of the 17 sawtooth faces (sites_v1 B173_middle), along the principal direction of their horizontal normals, +-20 m
sections.neighbour_wall: the LoD2 wall face of DEBY_LOD2_4959460 with the most patches inside the evaluation range (v6 LoD2 box run): vertical plane along its horizontal normal through the centroid of those patches, +-10 m
sections.old_upper_wall: the LoD2 wall face of DEBY_LOD2_4959326 with the most invisible patches (v6 LoD2 box run): vertical plane along its horizontal normal through the centroid of those patches, +-10 m
sections.content: prior (LoD2 or ALS mesh, registered), result seed 0 and seed 1 (TSDF mesh), GT points within 0.25 m of the plane

stage0.remaining_runs: 47 trainings of stages 1-3 (order) after stage 0; estimated from the measured time per run scaled by training views

concurrency: at most three Docker jobs at a time (shared host); trainings one per GPU; meshes one at a time
